findings: M338 identity and count agree between SNL96 and HB207; HB134/135 and SNL32 locate its pin below the upper channel.
HB135 labels M385 behind the track-brake link. Two stops allocated one per track brake; this is inferred from count and view.
HB134 channel registration predicts the source shaft 9.575922 mm aft and 15.269094 mm above the retained native shaft.
Ellipse fit to the source opening agrees with the manual center pick within four pixels; it does not resolve datum disagreement.
Shaft-referenced longitudinal bracket placement is mechanically clear but remains offset in the channel-registered source overlays.
Part thickness, transverse width, bore size, rounded hidden end and stop toe are estimates. Fastener pattern and connected brake linkage are not reconstructed.
The remaining source rivet stock lengths cannot be allocated merely by filling the existing thin-gusset joints. Allocation remains open alongside receiver design.

source_axis_residual.interpretation: Held-out source shaft center disagrees with retained model registration; no physical frame is moved to hide it.
